card.line: Kadesh was a city on the edge of Edom's land where Israel camped, received the spies' report, and stayed a very long time after refusing to trust God.

moments.title: The spies return
moments.text: The twelve men came back to Moses, Aaron, and all Israel at Kadesh and showed them the fruit of the land. Caleb said to take the land, but the others said the people were too strong.

moments.title: Israel's long stay
moments.text: After the people rebelled and were turned back, they wept before the LORD, but He would not listen. For this reason they stayed in Kadesh a very long time.

moments.title: A message to Edom
moments.text: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to the king of Edom. They asked to pass through his land on the King's Highway, but Edom refused and came out with a large army.

moments.title: Leaving for Mount Hor
moments.text: After Edom refused them, Israel turned away. They set out from Kadesh, and the whole congregation came to Mount Hor.
